resources.string: Reads on-screen Hebrew text from chat and social apps to detect offensive content and protect children from cyberbullying.
Persistent indicator that Shomer.AI monitoring is running
Protecting your child from harmful content

Shomer.AI helps protect your child from cyberbullying by checking Hebrew text shown on this device for offensive, abusive, hateful, violent, or inappropriate content.

How it works: Shomer.AI reads on-screen text in supported chat and social apps — WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, and Telegram — including open chats and comments. Because many apps hide their messages from standard accessibility tools, Shomer.AI mainly uses periodic screen capture together with text recognition (OCR) on our server to read what is visible on screen. Screen capture requires your explicit consent through a separate Android system dialog and may be declined.

Both messages your child receives and messages they send may be checked. Captured text is processed on our secure server and results are sent to the parent's device. Screenshots and message text are not permanently stored unless harmful content is detected.

By continuing, the guardian confirms they have explained this monitoring to the child and have obtained consent from all parties as required by applicable law.

Allow notifications so Shomer.AI can show the monitoring indicator and alert the parent device.
To monitor continuously, Shomer.AI must not be stopped by the battery optimizer. Tap below and select \"Don\'t optimize\" for Shomer.AI.
Enable Screen Capture for Open Chats
Screen capture active — open chats monitored
Screen capture inactive — only notifications/accessibility captured

Many apps (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook) hide their messages and comments from accessibility services. Screen capture lets Shomer.AI read on-screen text — open chats and comments — that is not accessible any other way, using text recognition (OCR) on the server. A system consent dialog will appear. This requires Android 5+ (API 21). You may decline — notification/accessibility monitoring will continue working.
Monitoring now includes periodic screenshots of messaging app screens. Screenshots are processed on the server for OCR text analysis and are not retained if no harmful content is found.
